Summer Grant Cycle

GENERAL GRANTS

Applications are accepted through July 19th, with funding decisions announced in July. Grants support organizations serving the LGBTQIA+ community in our four core program areas: Civil Rights, Health & Wellness, Arts & Culture, and Youth & Families. Priority is given to programs that promote dignity, justice, and measurable community impact throughout San Diego County.

HIV Funding Collaborative

HIV Funding Collaborative – 2026 Grant Cycle

The San Diego HIV Funding Collaborative invites organizations serving people living with HIV and AIDS to apply for funding. Through generous support from Red Dress Party San Diego and legacy donors like George A. Murphy, we collaboratively allocate resources to reduce the impact of HIV in the San Diego region. Please review our application guidelines before submitting to ensure your organization and programs align with our funding priorities.

Deadline extended to: March 14, 2026

Grant Requirements

Winter Grant Cycle

GENERAL GRANTS

Through our Grant Program, we open two grant cycles annually to support organizations empowering and uplifting the LGBTQIA+ community. Applications for our Winter Grant Cycle have been extended through March 14, 2026, with funding decisions made thereafter.

We invite organizations serving LGBTQIA+ communities to apply for grants that advance dignity, equity, and belonging in San Diego.
